analog_block_in_docs_intentionally_omitt: MDIO's only analog-keyword hit is the off-chip pull-up resistor on the open-drain MDIO line (IEEE 802.3 Clause 22/45: 'open-drain ... requires an external pull-up resistor 1.5 k to 10 k' to a separate pull-up supply 1.2 V to 3.3 V — see input/docs/IEEE_802.3_MDIO_Clause22_45.txt lines 22-23, 110, 112). That pull-up is a board passive powered by an external supply, NOT an on-chip analog block this IP must design; the deliverable IP is the digital MDIO management controller (STA/MMD frame engine). There is therefore no on-chip analog block to capture in L5.analog_blocks[]; the open-drain pad simply tri-states (Hi-Z) and the external resistor pulls the bus high, so L5 is intentionally left empty.
